subject.title: Proposal: Publish a provider compatibility matrix with deprecation policy

question: Should OpenClaw publish lifecycle states and minimum deprecation guarantees for provider/model-family/capability combinations, and which provider classes are covered by those guarantees?
rationale: Stable, experimental, deprecated, and broken labels plus notice windows are product support commitments that code inspection cannot define for official, bundled, external, and community-owned providers.

options.title: Scope official lifecycle guarantees
options.body: Define guarantees for official and bundled provider paths first, require external plugins to publish owner-scoped lifecycle metadata, and generate shared docs and CLI output from those records.

options.title: Publish documentation guidance only
options.body: Document non-binding support terminology and migration expectations without adding a machine-readable registry or CLI lifecycle surface.

options.title: Decline formal guarantees
options.body: Keep provider-specific docs, release notes, migrations, and live probes as the support model without promising standard deprecation windows.

recommendation.title: Scope official lifecycle guarantees
recommendation.body: Define guarantees for official and bundled provider paths first, require external plugins to publish owner-scoped lifecycle metadata, and generate shared docs and CLI output from those records.
